stories.headline: Finastra Sells Core Banking Business to Focus on Payments and Lending
stories.body: Private capital asset manager Pollen Street plans to acquire Finastra’s global core banking software business, Universal Banking (UB), and support UB as it becomes a standalone business. Pollen Street will provide investment to UB to help the company accelerate product innovation, strengthen customer delivery and expand capabilities, the companies said in a Friday (June 19) press release. stories.headline: The riskiest SpaceX stock trade of all had a big first week
stories.body: SpaceX's IPO did not just mint the biggest debut in market history and a trillionaire, but it also triggered a historic land grab in risky leveraged ETFs.
